sources.label: Custom Morphe patches for Helakuru Lite 3.2.0
sources.author: Bhashana
patch_list: Adds adjustable keyboard blur, transparency, Monet tint, and Gboard-style key backgrounds.
Adds a tap bloom and optional key dip animation.
Helakuru Lite Diagnostic No-op (no app changes)
Creates a comparison build without modifying Helakuru Lite code.
Export and import settings added by Morphe patches.
Adds independent haptic and system key click feedback settings.
Adds independent local photo backgrounds and hides the Pro image and Popular Themes catalogs.
Hold the spacebar and swipe to move the text cursor.
